hospital.Description: De-identified source hospital of the I-CARE consortium. This public release holds patients from hospitals A, B, D, E and F; C and G are not in it.

age.Description: Age in years at time of cardiac arrest.

rosc.Description: Time from cardiac arrest to return of spontaneous circulation.

ttm.Description: Targeted temperature management setpoint; n/a if not applied.

outcome.Description: Dichotomised neurological outcome at hospital discharge.

cpc.Description: Cerebral Performance Category at hospital discharge.

n_runs.Description: Number of BIDS runs (I-CARE segments) for this subject.

first_hour.Description: Hour after cardiac arrest of the earliest segment.

last_hour.Description: Hour after cardiac arrest of the latest segment.

n_hours_covered.Description: Number of distinct post-arrest hours with data.

powerline_frequency.Description: Mains frequency at the recording site.

n_eeg_channels.Description: EEG channel count(s) across this subject's runs.

bad_channel_fraction.Description: Fraction of channel-instances automatically flagged bad (flat / near-flat / mostly NaN).

sampling_frequencies.Description: Sampling rate(s) used for this subject, in Hz; several rates are separated by '/'.
